gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-spline-sans: Bushcraft draws every curve without a hint of swelling, its extra-wide spacing letting capitals barely rise above the lowercase. Spline Sans, with its wider-open curves and lower lowercase, makes the sharpest contrast.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-belgrano: Belgrano brings classic serif curves with open mouths, set against Cowboys, whose laser-etched line has big gaps between its stems. Long paragraphs in it would read traditional and unhurried.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-labrada: Cowboys traces each letter like a bent paperclip, with no swelling at all, and wide gaps between neighboring stems. Labrada, a dignified text serif, feels bookish and settled beside that wire-like heading.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-montaga: A constant-width trace, like a laser-etched line, runs through Cowboys, with big gaps between the stems of neighboring letters. Montaga, an editorial text serif, would read bookish over many pages.
gen-dafont-dogica-plus-jakarta-sans: Heavy, wide-set and loud, Dogica nearly lifts its lowercase to capitals. Plus Jakarta Sans, a precise monoline sans-serif with curve endings kept well apart, supplies the sharpest difference through its moderate lowercase height.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-plein: Playful and commanding, Early GameBoy stretches out wide with a skyward x-height, gently thickening curves. Plein, reliable, low and clean, gives each round letter a clear channel in.
gen-dafont-franchise-gf-noto-serif-ahom: Tall, tight and pipe-straight, Franchise jams its letters shoulder to shoulder. Noto Serif Ahom, dignified and traditional, brings a lofty lowercase and gently swelling curves against those straight pipes.
gen-dafont-nasalization-plus-jakarta-san: Friendly and floaty, Nasalization spaces its big lowercase letters well apart. Plus Jakarta Sans steps in beneath with precise monoline strokes and a more moderate lowercase, so the page moves from roomy to exact.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-chillax: Glowing, tall and stamped like metal type, Neon never changes its line width. Chillax loosens things with a casual sans line like spaghetti, and its lower lowercase lets the heading stand tall above it.
gen-dafont-neuropol-fs-public-sans: A single-weight outline feel runs through Neuropol, its c opening only a slim channel, which gives the headline a futuristic look. Public Sans opens everything back up, hefty and trustworthy.
